industry.zh: 网络安全、边缘网络与网站性能
industry.en: Network security, edge networks and web performance

tagline.zh: 帮助互联网服务变得更安全、可靠、快速。
tagline.en: Making internet services safer, more reliable and faster.

overview.zh: Cloudflare 是一家美国互联网基础设施企业，通过全球网络为网站、应用和企业网络提供安全、性能与连接服务。
overview.en: Cloudflare is a US internet infrastructure company providing security, performance and connectivity services for websites, applications and enterprise networks.

overview.zh: 公司产品包括内容分发、DDoS 防护、Zero Trust 网络安全和 Workers 边缘运行平台。岗位可能涉及网络协议、分布式系统、安全研究和客户解决方案。
overview.en: Its portfolio spans content delivery, DDoS protection, Zero Trust networking and Workers edge computing. Roles can involve networking, distributed systems, security research and customer solutions.

description.zh: 提升网站性能并防护网络攻击
description.en: Improves site performance and mitigates attacks

description.zh: 在全球网络边缘运行应用逻辑
description.en: Runs application code across an edge network

description.zh: Cloudflare 成立或启动该业务。

industry.zh: 前端云平台与开发者部署工具
industry.en: Frontend cloud platform and developer deployments

tagline.zh: 构建、部署和优化现代 Web 应用。
tagline.en: Build, deploy and optimize modern web applications.

overview.zh: Vercel 是一家美国开发者平台企业，为前端网站与 Web 应用提供托管、构建和持续部署能力，并支持现代全栈开发工作流。
overview.en: Vercel is a US developer platform offering hosting, builds and continuous deployment for frontend websites and web applications.

overview.zh: Vercel 维护 Next.js 框架相关生态，提供部署预览、性能优化与开发者协作工具。应聘岗位常涉及基础设施、框架、开发者体验及企业业务。
overview.en: Vercel is closely associated with the Next.js ecosystem and offers preview deployments, performance tooling and developer collaboration. Teams work on infrastructure, frameworks, developer experience and enterprise services.

description.zh: 网站和应用的构建、发布及运行
description.en: Build, publish and operate web applications

description.zh: React 全栈开发框架及相关工具
description.en: React framework for full-stack web applications

industry.zh: 跨境支付与多币种账户

tagline.zh: 让个人与企业更透明地转移和管理跨境资金。
tagline.en: More transparent international money movement and management.

overview.zh: Wise 于 2011 年以 TransferWise 名称创立，起初专注于跨境汇款成本和汇率透明度，现为个人与企业提供多币种资金管理服务。
overview.en: Founded in 2011 as TransferWise, Wise originally targeted the cost and opacity of international transfers and now offers multicurrency money management for people and businesses.

overview.zh: Wise 产品覆盖跨境转账、多币种账户、支付卡及面向企业的账户服务，不同地区功能受到当地金融监管限制。
overview.en: Wise products include international transfers, multicurrency accounts, cards and business services. Availability and regulatory requirements differ by jurisdiction.

description.zh: 跨国家地区发送和接收资金
description.en: Sending and receiving cross-border funds

description.zh: 持有、收付和使用多种货币
description.en: Holding and using multiple currencies

industry.zh: 在线教育与职业技能培训

tagline.zh: 与大学及企业合作提供全球在线课程和证书。
tagline.en: Online courses and credentials with universities and companies.

overview.zh: Coursera 由 Daphne Koller 和 Andrew Ng 于 2012 年创立，是一家在线学习平台，与大学及企业合作提供课程、专业证书与学位项目。
overview.en: Coursera was founded in 2012 by Daphne Koller and Andrew Ng. It partners with universities and businesses to offer online courses, professional certificates and degree programs.

overview.zh: 除了个人学习，Coursera 还向企业、校园及公共部门提供技能培养方案。岗位可能涉及在线教学体验、课程内容、企业销售与学习数据技术。
overview.en: Beyond individual learning, Coursera provides skills-development programs to organizations and institutions. Roles can span learning experiences, content, enterprise sales and education technology.

description.zh: 短课、专业课程及职业技能证书
description.en: Courses, specializations and career credentials

description.zh: 面向企业和机构的员工技能培训
description.en: Organizational and employee skills development

industry.zh: 知识管理与团队协作软件

tagline.zh: 将文档、知识库与工作管理整合在同一空间。
tagline.en: Documents, knowledge and workflows in one workspace.

overview.zh: Notion 是一家美国协作软件公司，提供可自由组合的文档、数据库、维基与项目空间，供个人及团队组织信息和业务流程。
overview.en: Notion is a US collaboration software company providing composable documents, databases, wikis and project workspaces for individuals and teams.

overview.zh: Notion 将模块化信息组织与团队协作结合，并持续增加自动化和 AI 辅助功能。相关岗位涉及编辑器、云服务、产品体验和商业化。
overview.en: Notion combines modular information organization with collaboration and adds automation and AI assistance. Roles span editors, cloud infrastructure, product experience and commercialization.

description.zh: 文档、知识库及数据库组织
description.en: Documents, wikis and databases

description.zh: 在工作空间内提供 AI 辅助写作和信息操作
description.en: AI assistance within workspaces

tagline.zh: 面向产品团队的任务追踪与交付协作。
tagline.en: Issue tracking and delivery for product teams.

overview.zh: Linear 成立于 2019 年，为软件产品团队提供任务、周期、路线图和跨团队项目协作能力，帮助工程与产品人员管理研发工作。
overview.en: Founded in 2019, Linear provides issues, cycles, roadmaps and cross-team coordination for software product organizations.

overview.zh: Linear 强调简洁迅速的界面和结构化产品开发流程，并探索团队与 AI Agent 协作。其岗位面向前端产品、后端基础设施、设计和客户团队。
overview.en: Linear emphasizes fast, focused interactions and structured product workflows, including human-agent collaboration. Roles can involve product engineering, infrastructure, design and customer teams.

description.en: Track work and iteration cycles

description.zh: 规划产品方向与项目交付

tagline.zh: 将搜索结果与来源引用整合到对话式答案。

overview.zh: Perplexity 是一家美国人工智能搜索产品公司，向用户提供基于互联网信息的问答服务，结合大语言模型与外部检索生成带来源引用的回答。
overview.en: Perplexity is a US AI search company combining language models with information retrieval to deliver answers accompanied by source references.

overview.zh: 其服务包括对话式搜索、研究型查询和面向不同设备的产品体验。生成内容仍需要用户核实，招聘岗位职责以企业官方板为准。
overview.en: The service supports conversational search, research tasks and use across devices. Generated answers still require verification; employment details are governed by official listings.

description.en: Search answers with linked sources

description.zh: 辅助多步骤资料搜集与综合
description.en: Assisted multi-step research and synthesis

industry.zh: 生成式语音与音频人工智能

tagline.zh: 让内容可通过自然语音实现多语言表达。
tagline.en: Natural-sounding voice and multilingual audio creation.

overview.zh: ElevenLabs 创立于 2022 年，研究和开发生成式音频 AI，起步于高拟真文字转语音，逐步拓展配音、语音设计与音频生成服务。
overview.en: Founded in 2022, ElevenLabs develops generative audio AI. It began with natural-sounding text-to-speech and expanded into dubbing, voice design and audio generation.

overview.zh: 其音频产品面向创作者、开发者和企业应用，也提供语音接口与工具。声音使用涉及授权和内容安全约束，实际职位要求须以官网为准。
overview.en: Its audio products serve creators, developers and enterprises through tools and APIs. Voice use raises consent and content-safety requirements; role eligibility follows official job postings.

description.zh: 从文字生成自然语音
description.en: Generate natural speech from text

description.zh: 将音视频内容跨语言配音
description.en: Multilingual dubbing of audio and video

tagline.zh: 在代码编辑器内整合人工智能编程协助。
tagline.en: AI coding assistance integrated into an editor.

overview.zh: Cursor 是由 Anysphere 团队开发的 AI 代码编辑器产品，帮助开发者在现有代码库中进行阅读、修改、生成和调试。
overview.en: Cursor is an AI code editor developed by Anysphere, helping developers explore, modify, generate and debug code in existing repositories.

overview.zh: Cursor 围绕开发者工作流提供聊天、代码改写、项目级检索和 Agent 式开发能力。其招聘岗位覆盖模型集成、编辑器、基础设施与开发者工具。
overview.en: Cursor includes chat, code editing, repository context and agent-like coding workflows. Relevant roles span model integration, editors, infrastructure and developer tools.

industry.en: Browser-based development and AI app creation

tagline.zh: 通过浏览器和 AI 助手降低应用开发门槛。
tagline.en: Lowering barriers to building applications with AI.

overview.zh: Replit 是一家美国软件开发平台，提供浏览器内的代码编辑、运行与应用发布环境，目标是让非专业开发者和工程师都能快速创建软件。
overview.en: Replit is a US software development platform providing browser-based editing, execution and application deployment for both novice and experienced builders.

overview.zh: Replit 将 AI Agent 接入从想法到可运行应用的流程，还提供协作开发与部署工具。岗位可能涉及编程环境、云基础设施、AI 代理和增长。
overview.en: Replit integrates an AI agent into the path from ideas to working applications, alongside collaboration and deployment. Teams work on runtimes, cloud infrastructure, AI agents and growth.

description.en: Assists app creation from natural language

industry.en: Product analytics, experimentation and engineering tools

tagline.zh: 为产品团队提供从分析到实验的统一工具。
tagline.en: A connected toolkit for product analytics and experimentation.

overview.zh: PostHog 创立于 2020 年，是一家面向产品工程师的数据工具公司，最初提供开源产品分析工具，后来扩展为面向软件构建者的产品与数据平台。
overview.en: Founded in 2020, PostHog started as an open-source product analytics tool and expanded into a broader product-and-data toolkit for software builders.

overview.zh: 平台覆盖事件分析、会话回放、功能开关、实验和相关调试工具。岗位可涉及数据基础设施、SDK、产品工程和开源社区。
overview.en: Its suite spans event analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments and debugging tools. Roles can involve data systems, SDKs, product engineering and open-source community work.

description.zh: 理解用户行为与转化路径
description.en: Understand user events and funnels

description.zh: 控制功能发布并开展实验
description.en: Manage feature rollouts and experimentation
